title: RENDER_PLAN must stay listed as available even with no dashboard client mounted
answers: Why does getAvailableCommands() include RENDER_PLAN with no dashboard open?
Assistant can't discover the preview command before navigating to a dashboard
Invariant for exposing mutation commands that can open their own page
body: Symptom: a caller checking dashboardMutationApi.getAvailableCommands() before any dashboard is loaded (e.g. from /explore) used to see an empty list, making RENDER_PLAN undiscoverable until a dashboard happened to be mounted. Fix/invariant: getAvailableCommands() unconditionally includes 'RENDER_PLAN' merged with whatever the active client (dashboard or notebook) reports, since RENDER_PLAN is handled by DashboardPlanPreview and can open its own /dashboard/new page rather than requiring a pre-existing client. Enforced in dashboardMutationApi.ts getAvailableCommands and execute (which special-cases RENDER_PLAN/END_PLANNING before falling back to currentClient()). If this invariant is broken, callers must poll/navigate to a dashboard first to discover a command meant to be usable from anywhere.

search: RENDER_PLAN command must remain listed as available unconditionally by getAvailableCommands() even when no dashboard is mounted, by merging 'RENDER_PLAN' with the active client's reported commands. RENDER_PLAN is handled by DashboardPlanPreview and can independently open /dashboard/new rather than requiring a pre-existing dashboard client, so it must not disappear from discovery when called from /explore or before any client mounts. The invariant is enforced in dashboardMutationApi.ts getAvailableCommands() and execute(), which special-case RENDER_PLAN/END_PLANNING before falling back to currentClient(). Applies to command discovery and dispatch in public/app/features/plugins/components/restrictedGrafanaApis/dashboardMutation/dashboardMutationApi.ts; breaking this invariant forces callers to navigate to a dashboard first just to discover a command that must work from anywhere.
